doc.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: How the Sadao Watanabe date came about through East Wind
summary: The Ito A&R men at East Wind, his first Japanese label, arranged it.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: I think it was the A&R man who worked for Eastwind at the time.

Yeah,88. It was Kyoshi Ito. I mean Yasahachi Ito and Kyoshi Ito. They both worked for Eastwind Records. They did a lot of stuff. That was the first company, the Japanese, that was the first Japanese company I had recorded for. It was Eastwind. Subsequently, I did some recordings for some lesser-known companies. Things like Afro , and a couple others that I don't recall the names of.
